entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I hope you can help. I need to return an item. It's the Aero Road Helmet I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. Oh, I really hope this is possible. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back for something else that came up unexpectedly.
I understand. Let me just pull that up. One moment... VF88602... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 28 days ago.

Is that... is that okay? The box is unopened, I swear. I picked a new color, thinking it would motivate me, but I just haven't even touched it. With a safety item like a helmet, I know it's important that it's new, and this one is.
No problem at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried. You have no idea what a help this is. Thank you so much, Diana.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label and instructions right now. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. The email just came through. Thank you again for being so helpful.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
